KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_CAST_STRIKE.title: Cast Strike
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_GUARD_PLATE.title: Guard Plate
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_FEEDER.title: Feeder
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_FEEDER.description:
Draw 1. Draw up to {ExtraDrawLimit:diff()} additional cards based on adjacent Scrap sides.
[gold]Module:[/gold] Draw 1.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_FLANK_PLATE.title: Flank Plate
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_FLANK_PLATE.descript:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block. At the left edge, gain {HandLeftBonus:diff()} more; at the right edge, draw 1.
[gold]Module:[/gold] Gain {ModuleBlock:diff()} Block; first Module gains {ModuleLeftBonus:diff()} more; last Module draws 1.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_POSITIONING_ARM.desc: Move another card in your Hand up to 2 positions left or right.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_EMERGENCY_MAINTENANC: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Repair a Product in your Hand by {Repair:diff()}. Can be played without a repair target.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BASIC_ASSEMBLY.title: Basic Assembly
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BASIC_ASSEMBLY.descr: Assemble 2 consecutive adjacent Parts from left to right into a 1-cost Product with 2 Durability. Add 1 Mechanical Scrap to the discard pile. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_ASSEMBLED_PRODUCT.de: Execute all Modules left to right. Lose 1 Durability after each use.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_MECHANICAL_SCRAP.des: Unplayable. When processed, replace it with a Secondary Conveyor.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BIOLOGICAL_SCRAP.des: Unplayable. When processed, replace it with a Secondary Energy Tank.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_SAW_BLADE.title: Saw Blade
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_CUSHION_PAD.title: Cushion Pad
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BOOSTER_PART.title: Booster
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BOOSTER_PART.descrip:
The adjacent Part to the right deals 50% more Attack damage this turn.
[gold]Module:[/gold] Increase the next Damage or Block Module by 50%.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_COUPLING_PART.title: Coupling
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_COUPLING_PART.descri:
The adjacent output Part to the right repeats 50% of its base Damage or Block.
[gold]Module:[/gold] Repeat the nearest previous output at 50% effectiveness.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_SIMPLE_REPAIR.title: Simple Repair
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_SIMPLE_REPAIR.descri: Repair a Product in your Hand by 1. If it was Broken, gain 6 Block.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_CONVEYOR_BELT.title: Conveyor Belt
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_CONVEYOR_BELT.descri: Move a card in your Hand to either edge. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_SCRAP_SORTING.title: Scrap Sorting
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_SCRAP_SORTING.descri: Process 1 Scrap. Upgraded: process 1 to 2 Scrap.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_QUICK_ASSEMBLY.title: Quick Assembly
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_QUICK_ASSEMBLY.descr: Assemble 2 adjacent Parts into a 0-cost Product with 1 Durability. Upgraded: draw 1 after assembling. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_TRIPLE_ASSEMBLY.desc: Assemble 3 consecutive Parts into a Product. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_PRECISION_ASSEMBLY.d: Assemble 2-3 consecutive Parts. Produce 1 less Scrap. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_DIVERTER_VALVE.title: Diverter Valve
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_DIVERTER_VALVE.descr: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. The adjacent Attack Part to the right hits all enemies this turn; unupgraded damage is reduced by 25%. Module: the next Damage Module hits all enemies.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_REINFORCED_FRAME.des: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. At the left edge, repair 1; at the right edge, gain 3 more Block. Module: first grants +1 maximum Durability; last prevents the first Durability loss.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_SCRAP_SMELTING.title: Scrap Smelting
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_SCRAP_SMELTING.descr: Exhaust up to 3 Scrap. Gain 4 Block per card. If at least 2, gain 1 Energy.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_TEMPORARY_PATCH.desc: Repair a Broken Product by 1. Its next use costs 0, then Exhaust it. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_REVERSE_CONVEYOR.des: Reverse up to 4 consecutive cards in your Hand. Draw 1.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_SCRAP_FILLING.title: Scrap Filling
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_SCRAP_FILLING.descri: Assemble with Scrap as a Block Module, reducing maximum Durability. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_FULL_AUTO_PRODUCTION: The first Assembly each turn draws 1 and produces 1 less Scrap.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_PREVENTIVE_MAINTENAN: The first Product used each turn does not lose Durability.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_SELF_REPAIR_CORE.des: Repair a Product by 2. Module: after use, exhaust a Scrap to repair 1.
Dismantle a Product and return its Parts to your Hand in reverse order. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_INDUSTRIAL_MIRACLE.d: Assemble 4 consecutive Parts. The Product repeats all output Modules on its first use. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_TEMPORARY_BUFFER.des: Temporarily store another card. If it separated two Parts, draw 1 after your next Assembly this turn. Return it to the far right after Assembly or before turn end. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BATCH_TAG.title: Batch Tag
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BATCH_TAG.descriptio: Mark a Part: first Module draws 1 after Assembly; last makes the Product cost 1 less this turn; upgraded middle Module gains 1 Energy. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BYPASS_RAIL.title: Bypass Rail
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BYPASS_RAIL.descript: Your next Assembly this turn may bridge exactly 1 Scrap between two Parts. Move that Scrap to either Hand edge afterward; draw 1 if it becomes adjacent to a Feeder. Upgraded: always draw 1. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_ROLLER_ASSEMBLY.desc: Draw 1, then put a Hand card on the bottom of your draw pile. Module: first puts a card on the bottom before drawing; last draws before putting a card back. Upgraded: draw 2 when played.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_OUTPUT_COUNTER.title: Output Counter
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_OUTPUT_COUNTER.descr: Gain 5 Block. At the right Hand edge after an Assembly this turn, draw 1. Module: gain 4 Block; as the last Module, draw 1. Upgraded: 8 and 6 Block.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_PROCESS_REVIEW.title: Process Review
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_PROCESS_REVIEW.descr: Swap any two adjacent Modules in a Product. If a Module newly satisfies a first, middle, or last condition, draw 1. Upgraded: costs 0. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_MATERIAL_EJECTOR.des: Remove a Module from a Product and return its Part to your Hand. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_SECONDARY_FEEDING.de: Choose up to 2 Parts from your discard pile and place them on top of your draw pile in your chosen order. If you chose an Attack and a Skill, draw 1. Upgraded: up to 3; draw 1 more if the first and last types differ. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_INTERLOCK_STATION.de: Power. Each turn, your first mixed Attack/Skill Assembly gains Block.
Playable only after an Assembly this turn. If the latest Product is leftmost, draw to 5; if rightmost, draw to 4 and gain 1 Energy; otherwise draw 2. Upgraded: 6, 5, or 3. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_MODULE_RECIRCULATION: Power. After a Product breaks, return one of its Parts to your Hand.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_FULL_LINE_REARRANGEM: Rearrange your entire Hand. Draw 1 per adjacent Part pair, up to 3. If both Hand edges are Parts, gain 1 Energy. Upgraded: costs 0. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_ENDPOINT_RECOVERY.de: Process Mechanical Scrap at the left edge and Biological Scrap at the right edge; both may trigger. Upgraded: either Scrap type is valid at either edge. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_CHIP_EJECTION.title: Chip Ejection
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_CHIP_EJECTION.descri: Deal 7 damage. If the adjacent card to the right is Mechanical Scrap, process it and deal 4 more. Module: deal 6 damage. Upgraded: 10, 5, and 8.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_CULTURE_CHAMBER.desc: Gain Block. Module: gain Block and create Biological Scrap after use.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_METABOLIC_PUMP.title: Metabolic Pump
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_METABOLIC_PUMP.descr: Gain 4 Block. Process up to 1 adjacent Biological Scrap on each side; gain 3 more Block per Scrap. Module: gain 5 Block. Upgraded: 6, 4, and 7.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_POLARITY_SORTING.des: Swap the positions of 1 Mechanical Scrap and 1 Biological Scrap in your Hand. Draw 1. Upgraded: no longer Exhausts.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_DUAL_STREAM_RECOVERY: Process up to one Scrap of each kind.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_MECH_BIO_COUPLER.des: Process 1 adjacent Scrap. If its two neighbors are one Mechanical and one Biological Scrap, process both instead, draw 1, and gain 1 Energy. Upgraded: costs 0.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_REMOTE_RECYCLING.des: Process Scrap from your discard pile. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_CLASSIFICATION_PROTO: Power. The first Scrap processed each turn grants an additional reward.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_LOCAL_RECLAMATION.de: Process an adjacent Scrap and gain Block.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_ZERO_WASTE_FACTORY.d: Power. After the first Assembly each turn, process Mechanical Scrap on the Product's left and Biological Scrap on its right. Upgraded: either type is valid.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_HETEROGENEOUS_GROWTH: Power. Processing both Scrap kinds in a turn increases Product output.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_TOP_BIN_INSPECTION.d: Look at the top 3 cards of your draw pile. You may put 1 Part among them at the left Hand edge; return the rest in order. Upgraded: look at 5 and choose either Hand edge. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BOTTOM_BIN_HOIST.des: Put the bottom card of your draw pile at the right Hand edge. If it is a Part, it costs 1 less this turn. Shuffle first if the draw pile is empty. Upgraded: costs 0.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_TOP_DECK_PREASSEMBLY: Assemble two Parts from the top of your draw pile. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_FIRST_IN_FIRST_OUT.d: Power. Each turn, move the first Part drawn to the left Hand edge and the second to the right edge; after positioning the second, draw 1. Upgraded: costs 1.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_REWORK_PICKUP.title: Rework Pickup
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_REWORK_PICKUP.descri: Return a card from your discard pile to your Hand. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_REWORK_INSPECTION.de: Inspect and reorder cards in your discard pile.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_REVERSE_BIN_EXCHANGE: Exchange cards between the top of your draw pile and discard pile.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_REWORK_BUS.title: Rework Bus
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_REWORK_BUS.descripti: Power. The first card returned from discard each turn draws 1.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_ARCHIVE_SAMPLE.title: Archive Sample
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_ARCHIVE_SAMPLE.descr: Exhaust a Part at either Hand edge, then draw 2. Upgraded: choose a Part anywhere in your Hand. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BLUEPRINT_INVOCATION: Choose an exhausted Part. Copy its Module to the end of your next Assembly this turn; that Product loses 1 maximum Durability. Upgraded: choose the first or last position. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_LEGACY_REPLICA.title: Legacy Replica
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_LEGACY_REPLICA.descr: Add a temporary 0-cost copy of an exhausted Part to the right Hand edge. It has Ethereal and Exhaust. Upgraded: choose either Hand edge. Exhaust.
KILLER_FACTORY_CARD_BLUEPRINT_LIBRARY.de: Power. Once each turn, add your last exhausted Part to the next Assembly.
